# Section 1: Overview

# Purpose
• Billable Qty Provision if FPPO for Part Schifly Handling.

# Business Requirement
There are cases, where the embroidery is being done in a very specific area of the fabric. So, the rate that is finalized with supplier is also for that specific area. Client requirement is that, a provision needs to be defined where they can specify that rate is appliable for a particular qty rather that the total qty of that fabric.

# Assumptions
• This change will not impact existing functionalities.

# Section 3.

# Functional Requirements

## Billable Qty Provision if FPPO for Part Schifly Handling

## FPPO Changes
• In FPPO (Old and New UI), we required additional of below three fields.
• Billable Qty: - Here user will enter that out of the total output qty, the rate is applicable on how much qty.
• Unit / Rate: - This will be calculated automatically based on the Total FPPO qty / Billable Qty. This cannot be edited by user.
• Billable Value: - This will also be calculated automatically based on Billable Qty * Rate.

[TABLE 1: Table 1 · 3 rows · columns: FPPO (text), Column 2 (text), Column 3 (text), Column 4 (text), Column 5 (text), Column 6 (text)]
| FPPO | Column 2 | Column 3 | Column 4 | Column 5 | Column 6 |
| FPPo | Rate | FPPO Qty | billable | unit per rate | Billable FPPO Value |
| Schifly | 20 | 100 | 30 | 3.333333333 | 600 |
|  |  |  |  | FPPO Qty / Billable Qty | Rate * Billable |
• The GST and additional charges and APR will also get calculated with this Billable FPPO Value.
• The provision will be for New UI of FPPO and Blanket FPPO.
• These addition of these 3 fields in FPPO will be enabled via a checkbox in Article (Service) master. If against a process the checkbox (Billable Qty) is enabled then for that process FPPO these fields will get visible in FPPO. This checkbox will be enabled from screen layout configurator.

## GRN Changes
• In case of GRN, since this is required for only roll based Stock. In GRN, there will be a field Named as “Roll Type” which will have two options by default as “Schiffli” and “Non-Schiffli”
• For these cases, against a shade whenever their user will split for a roll, by default two lines will come with Roll Type as Schiffli and Non-Schiffli.
• User will enter the roll no in Stock Movement No and based on that by default system will generate the WFX Stock Movement no as .1 and .2 as shown in above screenshot.
• Same is required in case of Export and import as well. Where in export file the roll type will come and user will enter the qty in Schiffli and Non Schiffli.
• Apart from that, detail excel is also attached with this issue id.
